verses.text: A Maskil of Asaph. Why, O God, have You rejected us forever? Your anger smolders against the flock of Your pasture.

segments.text: A Maskil of Asaph. Why, O God, have You rejected us forever? Your anger smolders against the flock of Your pasture.

verses.text: Remember Your congregation You acquired of old; You redeemed [as] the staff of Your inheritance this Mount Zion—in it You have dwelt!

segments.text: Remember Your congregation You acquired of old; You redeemed [as] the staff of Your inheritance this Mount Zion—in it You have dwelt!

verses.text: Lift up Your steps to the perpetual desolations—to everything done wickedly [by] the enemy in the sanctuary!

segments.text: Lift up Your steps to the perpetual desolations—to everything done wickedly [by] the enemy in the sanctuary!

verses.text: Your adversaries have roared within Your appointed place; they have set up their signs [for] signs.

segments.text: Your adversaries have roared within Your appointed place; they have set up their signs [for] signs.

verses.text: He made himself known like one bringing on high axes against a thicket of tree;

segments.text: He made himself known like one bringing on high axes against a thicket of tree;

verses.text: and now all its engravings they strike down with ax and hatchet.

segments.text: and now all its engravings they strike down with ax and hatchet.

verses.text: They have sent Your sanctuary into the fire, to the ground; they have desecrated the dwelling place of Your Name.

segments.text: They have sent Your sanctuary into the fire, to the ground; they have desecrated the dwelling place of Your Name.

verses.text: They said in their hearts, “Let us oppress them altogether!” They have burned all the appointed places of God in the land.

segments.text: They said in their hearts, “Let us oppress them altogether!” They have burned all the appointed places of God in the land.

verses.text: Signs for us we do not see; there is no longer a prophet, and there is no one among us knowing until when.

segments.text: Signs for us we do not see; there is no longer a prophet, and there is no one among us knowing until when.

verses.text: Until when, O God, will the adversary reproach? Will the enemy revile Your name forever?

segments.text: Until when, O God, will the adversary reproach? Will the enemy revile Your name forever?

verses.text: Why do You turn back Your hand, and Your right hand? May You remove [it] from the midst of Your bosom!

segments.text: Why do You turn back Your hand, and Your right hand? May You remove [it] from the midst of Your bosom!

verses.text: For God [is] my King from of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

segments.text: For God [is] my King from of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

verses.text: You divided the sea by Your strength; You broke the heads of the dragons upon the waters.

segments.text: You divided the sea by Your strength; You broke the heads of the dragons upon the waters.

verses.text: You crushed the heads of Leviathan; You gave him [as] food to the people of the dry places.

segments.text: You crushed the heads of Leviathan; You gave him [as] food to the people of the dry places.

verses.text: You burst open spring and stream; You dried up the enduring rivers.

segments.text: You burst open spring and stream; You dried up the enduring rivers.

verses.text: To You [is] the day, also to You [is] the night; You established the light and the sun.

segments.text: To You [is] the day, also to You [is] the night; You established the light and the sun.

verses.text: You set all the boundaries of the earth; summer and winter, You have formed them.

segments.text: You set all the boundaries of the earth; summer and winter, You have formed them.

verses.text: Remember this, an enemy has reproached YHWH, and a foolish people have spurned Your name!

segments.text: Remember this, an enemy has reproached YHWH, and a foolish people have spurned Your name!

verses.text: Do not give to the wild beast the soul of Your dove; do not forget the life of Your afflicted ones forever!

segments.text: Do not give to the wild beast the soul of Your dove; do not forget the life of Your afflicted ones forever!

verses.text: Look to the covenant! For the dark places of the earth are filled [as] habitations of violence.

segments.text: Look to the covenant! For the dark places of the earth are filled [as] habitations of violence.

verses.text: Do not let the oppressed turn back, having been disgraced; let the afflicted and needy ones praise Your name.

segments.text: Do not let the oppressed turn back, having been disgraced; let the afflicted and needy ones praise Your name.

verses.text: Arise, O God, defend Your cause! Remember the scorning of You from a fool all the day.

segments.text: Arise, O God, defend Your cause! Remember the scorning of You from a fool all the day.

verses.text: Do not forget the voice of Your enemies, the uproar of those rising against You, going up continually.

segments.text: Do not forget the voice of Your enemies, the uproar of those rising against You, going up continually.
